provenance.sampling_policy: Five evenly spaced frames across a 5.18-second video; visible evidence only.

assertions.summary: A large celestial formation is clearly visible, though only a few ships are individually readable.
assertions.rationale: Multiple ornate ships, dense soldier ranks, and many dark-red banners establish a large invasion force; the number of clearly readable ships is lower than the prompt's hundreds.

evidence.description: Large ships flank dense soldiers and banners.
Soldier formations extend down both sides of the jade stairs.
Deep ranks, banners, and distant ships remain visible behind the hero.

assertions.summary: A colossal Chinese heavenly gate and palace complex dominate the camera destination.
assertions.rationale: Tiered eaves, a monumental central opening, and connected palaces remain centered and grow throughout the forward camera move.

evidence.description: The central tiered gate first emerges clearly between ships.
The gate and palace wings anchor the deep background.
The enlarged gate dominates the upper frame.
The palace complex remains monumental behind the hero.

assertions.summary: A lone armored monkey warrior, red cape, and long staff are visible; his facing direction is ambiguous.
assertions.rationale: Exactly one prominent golden-furred warrior stands on the jade stair with red cape and staff, but the army appears behind him in the final sample.

evidence.description: One central figure stands at the top of the stair with a red cape and long weapon.
The closer view shows fur, armor, crimson cape, and staff.

assertions.summary: Foreground, middle ground, and deep background create convincing blockbuster scale.
assertions.rationale: Ships and figures frame the foreground, cloud stairs and formations occupy the middle ground, and the gate fills the deep background during a clear forward move.

evidence.description: Foreground ships frame the distant gate through cloud depth.
Ships, stairs, troops, and gate form several readable spatial layers.
Hero, formations, cloud banks, and palaces retain scale separation.
Hero close foreground, army middle ground, and gate background remain readable.

assertions.summary: No text or graphic mark is visible in any sampled frame.
assertions.rationale: The five supplied samples contain no subtitle, title, logo, watermark, or malformed text.

evidence.description: No text is visible in the opening cloud frame.
No text is visible among ships and gate.
No text is visible in the army establishing frame.
No text is visible around the hero and stairs.
No subtitle, logo, or watermark is visible in the hero frame.
